name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
description: Multi-agent development orchestrator for Claude Code that runs from an existing PRD/spec. Coordinates Codex back-end and Antigravity/AGY front-end subagents in parallel, with API/UI contracts, Codex back-end review, AGY (gemini-3.1-pro-high) front-end review, consolidated subagent context, a final implementation report and business-level user instructions.

plugins.name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
plugins.description: Orchestrator skill + /orchestrator slash command that drive a PRD/spec ingestion -> task classification -> API/UI contracts -> parallel Codex/Antigravity execution -> Codex back-end review -> AGY front-end review -> consolidated context -> implementation report workflow. Runs a preflight check for agy, codex-cli and required plugins before starting; cancels operation if anything is missing.
